vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ozbargain-monitor
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is a legitimate automation tool for monitoring OzBargain deals using the OpenClaw cron system. It includes standard bash scripts (manual_run.sh) and markdown instructions (SKILL.md) for managing deal alerts, deduplication via a local JSON state file, and troubleshooting via log inspection. No indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution were found.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are consistent with managing OzBargain cron jobs: it requires the openclaw CLI, reads/writes a local dedupe file, and uses openclaw to run/list/edit jobs — nothing appears disproportionate or covert.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the declared requirement (openclaw). No unrelated binaries, services, or credentials are requested. The included operations (cron add/run/edit/list, dedupe state) are appropriate for a cron-based OzBargain monitor.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions stay on-task: they run openclaw cron commands, require reading/writing a per-user dedupe JSON file in the user's OpenClaw workspace, and suggest grepping OpenClaw logs for troubleshooting. These actions are directly relevant to creating/updating runs and diagnosing delivery failures.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and only a small helper script; nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the installer. Risk from installation is minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request environment variables or external credentials itself, which is appropriate. It does assume the host's openclaw environment/session is configured with whatever channel/bot credentials are needed to deliver messages; those credentials are not requested by the skill but will be used by the openclaw CLI.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not forced-always and does not try to modify other skills or system-wide settings. It does read and update a user-scoped dedupe file in ~/.openclaw/workspace/data, which is expected behaviour for deduplication and normal for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: manage cron jobs via the openclaw CLI and keep a local dedupe list. Before installing, confirm you trust the environment's openclaw CLI (it will perform delivery using whatever credentials are already configured). Review and accept that the skill will read and write a per-user file like ~/.openclaw/workspace/data/ozbargain-sent-links.json and may read OpenClaw logs for troubleshooting. If you want stricter isolation, ensure the dedupe file is placed in a directory you control and verify openclaw's credentials/permissions beforehand.
